entries.name: lark-shared
entries.trigger: When first setting up lark-cli or running auth login
entries.description: Lark auth login, base URL config, and shared preflight for all lark skills.
entries.content: Run `lark-cli auth login` first; base URL from env LARK_BASE_URL; all lark-* skills depend on this one.
